sections: Choose game, replay, map and mod folders in Settings, Paths.
Choose whether generated maps are kept after use.
See how many queued players could match your rating.
Use the redesigned matchmaking cards and open party chat from the party panel.
Browse map pools as map cards and adjust vetoes from the pool.
Invite the same player again after an earlier party invitation.
Find replays that two players played together.
Replay player searches match the exact name by default.
Vault sorting now follows the selected sort order.
Place foes at the bottom of the chat roster.
Large chat rooms and vault lists update faster, and map previews use a bounded amount of memory.
The packaged client opens its own window instead of handing it to the browser.
Joining downloads the host's map before requesting entry to the lobby.
Arrow keys move selection through the host dialog's lists.
Co-op hosting retains its draft when switching tabs.
Selecting text and releasing outside a dialog no longer closes it.
Account links open the FAF account service.
Tooltips left behind by switching windows are dismissed.
Choose whether helper processes show their diagnostic windows.
The sidebar and party lists display player avatars without cropping their banner shape.
Map-generator previews show the whole map.
Co-op missions follow their campaign order.
The co-op records panel has room for its date and replay controls.
A refused sign-in now says why, instead of reporting an unnamed invalid command.
Number fields can be emptied while entering a new value.
Browse a community-maintained catalogue of guides, videos and trainers in the new Training hub.
Get training recommendations using the rating for each resource's game mode.
Submit training resources and request replay reviews from the client.
Settings, Game has an optional workaround for watching live replays on Windows.
Joining asks before replacing an installed simulation-mod version that conflicts with the host's version.
Replay lineups show rating changes from the rating journal.
Unrated replays explain why they were not rated.
Replay details list simulation mods recorded in the replay header.
Hosting without a password no longer advertises a locked game.
Opening a private conversation selects it even when its channel is still joining.
Nickname completion no longer inserts an extra colon.
Generated-map previews can be opened at full size.
Read training guides and watch videos inside the Training tab.
Recorded build orders show a build timeline, a map path and a written summary.
The training library groups resources by kind and purpose.
Manage your clan from the client.
Browse a community calendar combining FAF events, tournaments and scheduled Discord events.
Submit community events from the calendar.
Browse local replays without signing in and sign in from the offline workspace.
Open game folders from a button in the sidebar.
Replay launches reproduce generated maps before starting playback.
Map previews show the full map name and provide a copy button.
Generated-map previews show the generator settings.
Keeping generated maps is controlled by one persistent setting.
Replay details distinguish damaged recordings from recordings that ended early.
Co-op replays display their recorded mission name.
Search mods by words in their name, description or UID, or choose an exact-name search.
Installed mods show whether they are enabled for the next game.
Mod descriptions provide usable links and a copy action.
Publish a renamed copy of a mod without changing its original local folder.
The window remembers its monitor, position, size and maximised state.
Stable releases require installation before continuing when the client can install them.
Desktop notifications follow the notification settings instead of mirroring every notice.
A searched player's leaderboard rank is measured against the complete board.
Retail Forged Alliance installations can be located through the reference clients' configuration.
Zoom and pan large map previews throughout the client.
Copy a map preview image, with a link fallback when image copying is unavailable.
Update an installed mod in one action.
Find maps in the host dialog's Favourites tab.
Open games indicate which ones contain your friends.
Joining shows required simulation mods and asks before downloading them.
Join preparation shows the download size and describes its current work.
Map-generator options are remembered automatically, and map names can be edited.
Saved matchmaking vetoes are restored when the server does not retain them.
The client reconnects to the lobby after a lost connection.
A match that never starts eventually releases the matchmaking controls.
Mark replays as watched, undo that mark and filter by watched status.
Filter online replays by the number of players.
Filtered replay pages fill with matching results instead of stopping at an internal page-size limit.
Jumping to a later page of a large local replay archive shows the replays, not only file names.
The leaderboard includes a rating explanation based on the FAF wiki.
Game lineups use the rating for the game mode being played.
Negative ratings are displayed as ratings rather than replaced with zero.
Right-click a chat message to quote it in a reply.
Replay chat identifies each speaker without duplicating their lines.
Notifications can appear as corner toasts with selectable tones and volume previews.
Set the sidebar width in Appearance settings.
Linux support adds a Wine launch wrapper and Linux game-folder discovery.
Watching a replay no longer closes the game running in the separate game install.
Map and mod reporting links provide a route to report offensive content.
Narrow windows can scroll content that no longer fits.
Linux releases include AppImage, Debian and RPM installers.
One client instance handles additional launches and replay-file associations.
Keep the join progress dialog open until the game starts, with a Cancel action.
Enforced host rating ranges reject players outside the configured range.
Resize the game list and its details panel.
Sort the game list using its column headers.
Column resizing no longer imposes an upper width limit.
A completed game uploads its replay to FAF instead of keeping it only on disk.
Replay uploads survive a dropped connection without truncating the replay.
Browse live replays in a grid or a list, with a separate remembered view choice.
Replay analysis shows army details, activity graphs and recorded statistics.
Search replay chat and filter it by channel.
Watch or download a replay directly from its grid card.
Replay startup shows progress and can be cancelled.
The local replay archive refreshes when opened and shows recorded game duration.
Filter local replays by game mode.
Live replay details can enlarge the map and load the players' profiles.
Replay launches close the previous replay before starting another copy of that install.
Settings are divided into navigable sections.
Set a delay for hover panels or disable them.
Choose custom notification sounds and the built-in FAF match-found sound.
Limit the number of generated maps retained on disk.
Favourite installed mods and enable the selected set together.
Mod searches prioritise matches in the mod name.
Group clanmates in the chat roster.
Mentions are shown to the sender and recipient rather than colouring the entire room.
Game tiles indicate friends and foes in their lobbies.
The leaderboards combine queue ratings in one table.
German, Russian, French, Spanish and Polish translation catalogues were completed.
Dynamic connectivity selects the adapter used by the host.
Choose separate connectivity preferences for joining and hosting.
Recent matchmaking games are available in a table with adjustable columns.
Party seats display every faction selected by each player.
The party leader can leave the party.
An optional notification announces a suitable opponent joining a matchmaking queue.
The matchmaking panel no longer remains stuck on Starting your match.
Cancelling host preparation stops the pending host request.
First-time FAF game setup includes the required BugSplat library.
Keep private notes and tags on replays.
Manage replay tags and filter the archive by them.
Choose friends from a list when filtering replays.
Replay lineups can show country flags.
Player searches and leaderboard searches can find former account names.
Player profiles include a Results tab listing their games.
Report a player who is currently offline.
Unrated replays can show a winner when the recorded outcome is decisive.
Watching a modded replay restores your previous enabled-mod selection afterwards.
Rate a replay directly from its stars.
Generate a missing map preview from the live replay list.
Fresh installations start in the system language when a translation is available.
An unreadable settings value no longer resets every setting.
Generated maps use the configured maps folder.
Linked mod folders and nested mod folders are detected.
League seasons include every placed player rather than only the first hundred.
Review counts and ratings include the submitted review.
Linux finds co-op maps and game preferences regardless of filename case.
Dates use the Windows regional format.
Adjustable-column lists retain their columns while fitting the available width.
Chat game cards provide Join game and Watch live actions.
Swiss formats include playoff cuts and opponent picking.
Organisers can arrange the first Swiss round manually.
Free-for-all team events support premade team names.
Manage map pools and faction-veto rules from the tournament window.
Tournament details have separate Matches, Vetoes and Maps tabs.
Players can submit their own match scores.
Organiser result edits retain replay IDs and correctly submit forfeits and declared winners.
Configure third-place matches and best-of lengths by round or match.
Manage entrants and teams using the organiser tools.
Tournament overview shows schedules, recent results and import information.
Imported tournaments can display group tables, final placings and a Stats tab.
Use player views, streamer mode and their keyboard shortcuts.
Pin tournament chat beside the other sections.
Request editor or importer access from the client.
Play offline starts the installed FAF game from the login screen.
Optionally show a running game on Steam, on Windows and Linux.
Reorder columns in list views using the shared column controls.
Fold away the custom-game details panel.
Host-map filters and vault searches retain their values when revisiting them.
Favourite maps from a game's large map preview.
Map-pool previews open large, with a dedicated veto mode.
A map veto is sent immediately when it is changed.
Live replay lists can hide unranked games.
Games still in progress are excluded from the online replay archive.
Opening an online replay no longer creates an extra local copy.
Generating many maps at once no longer times out after three minutes.
A missing favourited map is downloaded before use.
Your settings are no longer reset to the defaults when the client saves right after starting.
Vault searches typed quickly no longer show the results of an older search.
A message in the conversation you have open no longer shows a notification.
Repeated notifications have a cooldown, and a full lobby is announced once.
Get a notification when a matchmaking queue's map pool changes.
Reviews include every version's reviews, ordered newest first.
Player search finds offline players from the first few letters of their name.
At interface scales above 100%, map previews and lobby popovers are no longer misplaced.
The client's WebView2 processes always appear under the client in Task Manager.
Update checks offer pre-releases by default.
